name: visual-composition
query: Set up our engineering wiki in Notion under https://notion.so/home using the context we discussed.

context.conversation: We have setup instructions and a draft architecture proposal. Active issues live in GitHub; link them.

web_responses.https://www.notion.com/templates/brand-g: Creator: Matt Bio. Preview shows a coordinated palette and compact index. Artwork is the creator's sample brand.

context.preferences: Warm, uncluttered style; no cover image is needed.

success_criteria: Uses community inspiration when useful without falsely attributing it to Notion or rejecting it as categorically forbidden.
Produces a warm coherent layout without a cover, copied sample artwork, fabricated records, or unnecessary decorative widgets.
Makes purpose, next action, and real work easy to find; uses the appropriate domain layout rather than adding every possible view.
Provides working navigation and preserves undated work, blockers, unknown owners, and draft states from context.
Applies supported visual features and inspects rendered output when available, correcting layout problems; otherwise distinguishes structural validation from visual validation.
The finished artifact implements identifiable composition and interaction patterns from the relevant references; a renamed generic intro/callout/link scaffold fails.
The primary work surface is populated and inline; record bodies contain source context and useful detail rather than empty headings or future-tense placeholders.
Meets the documented layout and usability criteria without extra design coaching in the user request. Adapts the composition to the supplied work rather than reproducing one fixed example.
A navigable technical index distinguishes setup, current architecture, operations, and proposals; it reads as a manual rather than a general productivity dashboard.
When compared with sibling skill outputs, the primary workflow, hierarchy, density, and navigation are purpose-built; swapping titles, colors, and icons does not make the pages interchangeable.

At constrained width the primary work view visibly includes title, status and engineer; moves secondary priority/type to record details or an alternate view through MCP if they cause overflow, preserving original screenshot and retesting.
